scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible because MD simulation raw output is not submitted. Compare reported buckling onset strains to paper gold with per-coverage absolute tolerance 0.2% strain, which captures the quantitative result and the coverage-dependent trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold buckling onset strains from paper Table 1
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported values; the checker compares agent's computed values to them.

outputs.description: Buckling onset strains for each hydrogen coverage, to be compared against the paper's reference values.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare each strain to the hidden gold with an absolute tolerance and verify the coverage-dependent trend.
